subtasks.objective: Fix SEC-07: secure the merge_bills endpoint in ury/ury_pos/api.py (lines ~924-1026). Currently any authenticated user can merge/modify any two draft POS Invoices because there is no role/permission/branch check and the save uses doc.save(ignore_permissions=True). Add authorization: verify the current session user has write permission on BOTH POS Invoices (frappe.has_permission("POS Invoice", "write", doc=primary_doc) and same for secondary_doc, throwing frappe.PermissionError otherwise) and verify both invoices belong to the same branch (compare the branch field; throw if they differ or if the user's permitted branch does not match, following how other endpoints in the same file resolve the caller's branch). In the nested update_merge_details() function, drop ignore_permissions=True from doc.save() so the write runs under the caller's permissions. Keep all existing validation logic, merged-details table behaviour, and the success/error response shape unchanged.
subtasks.acceptance: merge_bills in ury/ury_pos/api.py: (1) raises a PermissionError (not swallowed into the generic success path) when the caller lacks write permission on either invoice; (2) refuses to merge invoices from different branches; (3) contains no ignore_permissions=True save; (4) the happy path for an authorized same-branch user still returns {"status": "success", ...} and populates custom_merged_pos_invoice / custom_merged_pos_invoice_details exactly as before; (5) python -m py_compile ury/ury_pos/api.py succeeds.
